incidents.summary: Vacker v. Eleven Labs, Inc. (D. Del.) alleged unconsented use of professional voice recordings in training data; later coverage records a confidential 2025 settlement without classwide adjudication.
incidents.remediation: Public coverage does not describe a customer-account compromise or a published technical remediation of an API credential leak.
incidents.limitation: Privacy/biometric litigation, not a confirmed account-data breach; current live authentication unverified.
